svg.title: Electron waves on orbits
svg.desc: (a) Standing waves on a string fixed at both ends. (b) An allowed orbit: the electron’s wave fits a whole number of wavelengths around the circumference, 2πr = nλ, and joins itself smoothly (constructive interference). (c) A forbidden orbit: the circumference is not a whole number of wavelengths, 2πr′ ≠ nλ′, so the wave does not join up and cancels itself (destructive interference).
